points: \item Built YOLO object detection system for National ID hologram authentication, achieving robust counterfeit detection using transfer learning and synthetic training data generation.
\item Optimized computer vision pipeline by eliminating redundant processing steps, reducing per-card detection time from 7 minutes to 3 minutes while maintaining high accuracy.
\item Developed end-to-end credit card default prediction project using Docker and CI/CD, achieving 87% model accuracy on 30,000+ customer transaction records.
\item Conducted exploratory data analysis on large-scale datasets to identify key features that improved predictive model performance and business insights.
\item Implemented data validation and preprocessing pipelines for ML workflows, reducing manual data preparation effort and ensuring data quality.
\item Containerized and deployed ML solutions using Docker, CircleCI, and AWS, gaining hands-on experience in production ML deployment workflows for internships.
